messages:
Sam T: heads up  noticed a small cluster of invoice previews showing duplicate session credits for some tenants after the clientlib rollout. looks like session_id sometimes flips mid-session so preview counts session twice. anyone else seeing this?
Leah M: saw a couple of those. sample: tenant tn-310, preview run pr-2026-04-02-14. session_start shows session_id s-9a7, later events have s-9a7-v2 and preview aggregates both. final invoice dedupes correctly though.
Victor R: interesting. did the clientlib switch change how session_id is generated? We recently bumped clientlib to add region suffix to avoid collisions.
Sam T: yes clientlib v2 appends a region token when it falls back to replica routing. that means same logical session yields two different session ids in-flight if fallback occurs mid-session.
Leah M: consequence: preview is generated at edge by grouping on session_id; billing tally uses canonical session_key derived in ingest. so previews look like double credits but invoices are fine. CS is confused when they see the preview.
Victor R: two fixes: (1) change clientlib to emit stable_header X-session-stable-id that never changes across retries/fallbacks, or (2) change preview aggregator to map sessions by canonical fingerprint that ingest will compute (but that requires sharing canonical logic).
Sam T: which is quicker?
Victor R: (1) is lower risk and fast: small clientlib patch, and edge will set X-session-stable-id for preview. (2) is sweeping and needs coord w/ ingest and preview services.
Leah M: telemetry concern: adding X-session-stable-id to traces increases trace-label cardinality. we should restrict to a canary tenant list and gate via env var. also add a metric preview_session_dup_rate to watch.
Sam T: agreed. plan: Victor to prototype (1) and a temporary edge middleware that copies stable header to preview's grouping key when present. Leah to add metric + alert if preview_session_dup_rate > 0.2% across non-canary tenants for 30m. I'll notify CS and file a quick FAQ to explain previews vs final invoice.
Victor R: will open a PR for clientlib v2.1 with X-session-stable-id. snippet I plan to add to clientlib: 
```
// clientlib session id stable header
function computeStableId(sessionBase, tenantId) {
  // deterministic, no region suffix
  return hash(`${tenantId}:${sessionBase}`)
}
setHeader('X-Session-Stable-Id', computeStableId(session.id, tenant.id))
```
Leah M: looks good. please ensure stable id is idempotent across retries and doesn't leak PII (use hashed value).
Victor R: will do. I'll also add a feature flag so we can enable for canary tenants only. ETA ~1 day for PR + canary.
Sam T: ingest-bot: kicked a synthetic replay to emulate v2 client switching mid-session to check how preview behaves.
eng-metering-bot: synthetic run 1800000100 completed  10 tenants, 1200 events, pre-stable-id: 9 preview dup-session incidents, post-stable-id (simulated): 0 preview dup-session incidents. replay details: https://internal/ci/1800000100
Leah M: nice. I'll add alert thresholds and a short console note on preview cards: "Preview may show duplicate sessions during clientlib rollout; final invoice dedupes." small UX tweak so CS doesn't panic.
Sam T: thanks all. if canary looks clean after 6h we roll the clientlib patch and enable edge middleware globally. logging follow-ups in #eng-platform-action-items. :thumbsup:
